ICYMI: Senator Imee Marcos stirred controversy after reviving rumors about her brother President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.’s alleged drug use, dragging First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, their son Sandro, and members of the President’s wealthy inner circle, including Iñigo Zobel, Edvee Cruz, Tonyboy Floirendo, and Anton Lagdameo, into what she insinuated as his supposed “coke crew.”

In a fiery tirade on the second day of the INC protest in Manila, Imee claimed that she and other family members had long been aware of the President’s supposed drug problems and had tried, unsuccessfully, to get him off his addiction.
